summary: Read all 216 original lines; corrected release tracks, performance/security claims, current routing/VM support, quick-start prerequisites and quiz links.
findings: Preserved verified August release history. Corrected edge-26.7.1 to the GitHub published date July 21, 2026 (original said July 16), with the undefined-Service-port fix and Gateway API check. Added pinned public edge-26.9.1 context without treating it as a stable distribution version or compatibility guarantee.

Removed unsupported universal 10MB/<1ms and product complexity/performance rankings. Replaced the redundant figure, whose footer repeated those values, with an accurate component-role table. Both figures were visually reviewed; assets remain unchanged for parent-owned regeneration/source-sync.

Corrected Istio auto-mTLS/ambient comparison and Cilium authentication-vs-encryption boundaries. Linkerd routing includes Gateway API request properties; SMI is a legacy workflow, while ServiceProfiles remain supported.

Corrected categorical VM-unsuitable guidance: official mesh expansion supports ExternalWorkload with a separate external identity/bootstrap/network design. Distinguished non-HTTP TCP, opaque and bypassed ports from HTTP-level capabilities.

Scoped automatic mTLS to eligible meshed TCP peers; default inbound policy accepts unmeshed plaintext. Workload leaf validity/automatic renewal is separate from default one-year issuer/trust-anchor rotation and multicluster shared trust.

Added exact CLI/distribution and Gateway API prerequisites, render/review stages and CA lifecycle. Replaced namespace-wide live-Deployment round-tripping with intended-workload injection/restart. check --proxy is a data-plane check, not the control plane; Viz requires its own configured extension/backend.

Replaced the missing own-GitHub quiz README URL with six existing relative quiz paths. Replaced the obsolete /2/overview reference with /docs/overview. No live cluster/AWS operations or destructive sample execution.

summary: Full installation guide audited and corrected using pinned source/archive/CLI evidence, including HA, PKI, CNI, Viz, EKS, upgrade and removal.
findings: Read all1031original lines. Replaced unsupported2.16+ and incorrect plus-only Kubernetes table with documented milestone ranges and released edge minimum1.31/tested1.36 distinction; GatewayAPI1.5.1 prerequisite is explicit and passing preflight is not upper-bound compatibility proof.

Pinned public CLIedge-26.9.1 and charts2026.9.1 separately. Correct OS asset names and official SHA256 verification cover Linux/macOS and Windows windows.exe; deprecated installer defaults edge and uses LINKERD2_VERSION, not --version. Avoided persistent shell-profile edits and unsupported stable artifact assumptions.

Kept valid root controller resource keys and Viz dashboard keys after checking archive templates; base-values absence was not treated as proof of unsupported fields. Corrected proxy.logLevel/logFormat and removed ignored namespace.labels. Actual log output adds header/request suppression rules.

Replaced incorrect hand-built HA settings with packaged values-ha.yaml. Original render had3replicas but noPDB and missing main controller resources; fixed renders have3PDBs, node-required/zone-preferred anti-affinity and Fail injector policy. HA is redundancy, not quorum or an unconditional availability guarantee.

Corrected Viz persistence map semantics and required accessMode:ReadWriteOnce; original rendered null. Kept valid web port8084 and documented separate admin/readiness9994. Removed fictitious grafana.enabled deployment switch and authentication interpretation of enforcedHostRegexp. Added external-Prometheus alternative and single-replica/Recreate/storage prerequisites.

Removed unavailable linkerd jaeger and viz upgrade commands. CLIhelp exit0 alone is insufficient because unsupported viz upgrade --help prints parent help. Current tracing needs separate collector/backend and context propagation; legacy Jaeger data/resources need migration and original-owner cleanup.

CNI must be ready before CNI-enabled control-plane install. Added native/regular inspection and the released Identity bootstrap exception, which deliberately disables native proxy/startup wait. Clarified primary-CNI chaining, Cilium settings and Fargate DaemonSet restriction.

Removed obsolete EKS1.28 creation and unnecessary destination IAM role. Replaced unauthenticated public Viz ALB recipe with localhost administration and explicit authenticated-ingress requirements. Corrected internal NLB controller class/annotations, TCP transport and unconsumed gateway.resources.

Upgrade planning preserves owner, trust credentials, intentional values and supported intermediate/skew paths. Extensions rerender install rather than nonexistent upgrade commands. Data-plane version inspection now checks actual images in both container lists.

Fixed trust-root lookup from ConfigMap, default-vs-external issuer cert keys and all-certificate bundle inspection. Removal now unmeshes applications first, inventories custom resources/namespace ownership, and treats CNI cleanup separately. No destructive command executed.

Scope limits: Smallstep generation, PowerShell/other-architecture execution, live EKS/CNI, persistent-volume behavior and end-to-end tracing/metrics were not tested. The bundled chart actually defaults to Prometheusv2.55.1/6h; no blind latest-tag compatibility claim. No images in this guide.
validation: All1031original lines perlocale read, including installation, upgrade and uninstall examples. Original snapshots /tmp/mesh-linkerd-install-original-{en,ko}.md.
Five chart archives matched official index SHA256; native Linuxarm64 CLI matched release digest/version. Other platform asset metadata verified; no unsupported runtime-testing claim.

14 offline Helm render cases passed: base/HA/CNI/Viz-persistence/external-Viz/multicluster for each locale, plus CNI and CRD charts. Checked actual requests, log selectors, proxy placement,3PDBs, affinity, PVC, endpoint URL and NLB class/ports. Evidence /tmp/mesh-linkerd-validation/installation-final-report.json.

Original negative characterization retained: HA lackedPDB/resources; Viz PVC accessMode null. Initial validation expectations were corrected to account for documented Identity regular-sidecar bootstrap and chart-added log suppression, not by altering valid product behavior.

26Bash blocks perlocale parsed; two actual jq regular/native proxy cases passed. EN/KO Bash/YAML/PowerShell examples identical. Smallstep flags checked against official reference; PowerShell and crypto generation not executed.

Current6-page Linkerd batch:8YAMLblocks/62Bashblocks, links/fences/duplicatekeys/known404checks0errors. Scopedgitdiffcheckclean. Clean docs:test110/110passed; log /tmp/kubernetes-docs-full-review/docs-test-linkerd-install-clean.log.
